**ID:** MP-CGA-010 | **Priority:** P1 | **PRD refs:** FR6 | **Status:** draft
**Group:** MP Content Generation Agent (`mp-content-generation-agent`)

---

# Hermes — minimal diagnostics UI for content-generation runs

## Summary

There is currently no Hermes dashboard page for content-generation run history. This ticket ships a minimal, read-only diagnostics page in `apps/hermes/dashboard` that lists recent `ContentGenerationRun` records with filters for time range, ticker, and outcome, and provides a detail view per run. Operators can triage failures and verify skips without digging through logs.

## Scope

- In scope:
  - New page (or embedded panel within the existing Hermes agent section) at an appropriate route — e.g. `/agents/content-generation/runs` — using the Next.js App Router conventions already in `apps/hermes/dashboard`.
  - A table of recent diagnostic runs, defaulting to newest-first, with columns: `createdAt`, `tickerId`, `outcome` (with a colour-coded badge: green/success, yellow/skipped, red/failed), `stage`, `errorCode`, `durationMs`.
  - Filter controls: **time range** (date-range picker or start/end inputs), **ticker** (text input or select), **outcome** (multi-select: success / skipped / failed).
  - Row expand **or** a detail view (separate route or slide-over panel) showing: full `message`, `errorCode`, `stage`, `agentVersion`, `pipelineRunId`, and a link to the associated newsletter when `newsletterId` is present.
  - Data fetched via the typed `@workspace/agent-data-api-client` `contentGenerationRuns.list(...)` SDK method (MP-CGA-002); no raw fetch calls.
  - Pagination or infinite scroll for the list (follow the existing pattern used in other Hermes list pages).
  - Read-only: no "replay run" button, no delete, no edit.
  - Follow `react-component` and `organized-src-structure` skills for component placement and file naming.
- Out of scope:
  - Config editing for the content-generation agent (that is a Hermes config form feature, separate from diagnostics).
  - Alerting or notifications (PRD phase 2).
  - Writing or mutating diagnostic records from the UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Navigating to the diagnostics page renders a table of recent `ContentGenerationRun` records fetched from `GET /content-generation/runs`.
- [ ] Default sort is newest-first (`createdAt` descending).
- [ ] Filters (time range, ticker, outcome) update the query and re-fetch results without a full page reload; URL params reflect the active filters for shareability.
- [ ] Each row's `outcome` is visually distinguished (badge or text colour: success = green, skipped = yellow/amber, failed = red).
- [ ] Expanding a row or navigating to a detail view shows: `message`, `errorCode`, `stage`, `agentVersion`, `pipelineRunId`, and a linked `newsletterId` (if present).
- [ ] When `newsletterId` is present, it renders as a navigable link to the newsletter detail view (or a copy-to-clipboard fallback if no newsletter detail route exists yet).
- [ ] An empty state is displayed when no records match the current filters (not a blank page or unhandled loading state).
- [ ] Loading and error states are handled: a spinner or skeleton during fetch, an error message if the SDK call fails.
- [ ] The page is accessible via the Hermes navigation (sidebar or agent-section nav link).
- [ ] No raw HTTP paths — all data access uses the typed SDK method.
- [ ] `pnpm code-quality` (lint + type-check) passes for `apps/hermes/dashboard` with no new errors.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-CGA-002 (diagnostics contract + SDK providing `contentGenerationRuns.list(...)`)
- Blocks: none (this is the terminal UI ticket in the batch)

## Stacked delivery

This ticket can be merged once MP-CGA-002 is on `main`. The page will display an empty table (no records) until MP-CGA-007 starts writing diagnostic records — an empty table is an acceptable initial state, not a broken experience.

No feature flag is required. If the team prefers to hide the navigation link until MP-CGA-007 is merged (to avoid operator confusion from an always-empty table), add `HERMES_CGA_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED=false` as a feature flag following the `env-variables` skill. Remove the flag once MP-CGA-007 is on `main`.

**Flag details (if used):**

- Env key: `HERMES_CGA_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED` (server-only)
- Default: `false` until MP-CGA-007 merges
- Remove in: the MP-CGA-007 PR, or a dedicated cleanup commit immediately after

**Merge order:** Branch from `main` after MP-CGA-002 merges. Independent of the agent feature stack (MP-CGA-003–009).

## Notes

- Follow the `organized-src-structure` skill: new page component in `app/agents/content-generation/runs/page.tsx` (or equivalent App Router path); detail panel/route alongside it; shared filter components in `components/` per the existing Hermes dashboard pattern.
- Follow the `react-component` skill for component structure and co-located test placement.
- Use the same date-range picker and filter component patterns already in use in other Hermes list views to maintain UX consistency — check `apps/hermes/dashboard` for existing filter implementations before creating new ones.
- The `outcome` badge component may be reusable across future agent diagnostics pages — consider placing it in a shared `components/agent-run-outcome-badge.tsx` from the start.
- Pagination: the `GET /content-generation/runs` SDK method should support a `limit` / `cursor` or `page` parameter (defined in MP-CGA-002); implement the UI to match whatever pagination pattern the contract uses.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/content-generation-agent-prd.md
